newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end lower on soy sag, technicals.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end lower on soy sag, technicals.

text.p: Technical selling amid a drop in soybean futures pressed CBOT soy product futures to a lower close, traders said.
Commercial selling also was noted with Cargill Inc a key seller of 300 lots of December soymeal and 300 lots of December soyoil, traders said.
The soy complex dropped despite rain-delayed harvesting of the U.S. soybean crop, slow farmer selling and recent active exports of soybeans and soy products.
Traders said sell stops were hit early but day trade short covering buoyed the market near the close.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 17,500 contracts, up from 15,749 Monday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 13,000 contracts, up from 11,971 Monday.
Soyoil closed 0.03 to 0.20 cent per lb lower, with December down 0.03 at 23.10. Soymeal was $1.80 per ton lower to $0.30 higher, with December down $1.10 at $228.90.
